reason: A local migration and validation utility that converts Claude Code conversation history into DeepSeek Harness session files, preserves titles and workspace paths, and can attach imported sessions to workspaces.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话历史转换为 DeepSeek Harness 会话文件，保留标题和工作区路径，并支持验证及附加到工作区。
summaries.en: Converts Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness session files while preserving titles and workspace paths, with validation and workspace attachment support.

capabilities: Reads Claude Code session history from local JSONL files
Converts conversations into DeepSeek Harness session storage
Creates or reuses workspaces and attaches imported sessions
Supports dry-run previews and format validation
